newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's OSROK buys 6,695 tonnes of aluminium.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's OSROK buys 6,695 tonnes of aluminium.

text.p: South Korea's Office of Supply (OSROK) has bought 6,695 tonnes of aluminium, traders said on Friday.
OSROK bought 3,660 tonnes from LG Metals Corp for delivery to Inchon warehouse and 2,140 tonnes from LG International Corp for delivery to Pusan warehouse.
It also purchased 895 tonnes from Halla Resources Corp, with 695 tonnes to be delivered to Taegu warehouse and the remaining 200 tonnes to Kwangju warehouse.
Traders said the aluminium must be high-grade primary ingots of London Metal Exchange-registered brand.
Delivery has to be made within three months of purchase.
